Gathering ten shards allows him to move forward with his buyers, after which his business concerns shift toward the operations of the Venture Company itself.

quest:610.text: "Pretty Boy" Duncan. After tracking down Catelyn the Blade on behalf of her father, an adventurer learns that her weapon is no longer in her hands. She demands that her lost dagger be retrieved from a pirate named Pretty Boy Duncan before she cooperates further. Following the trail from Ansirem's Key leads directly to Catelyn the Blade, who ran away from a quiet life of scholarship and dusty tomes alongside mages. She cannot hand over her dagger at her father's request, since she no longer has it. If anyone hopes to secure her blade, they will first have to deal with the Bloodsail Buccaneer who took it. Catelyn suffered an uncharacteristic defeat at the hands of Pretty Boy Duncan, who struck her unconscious and made off with her signature weapon. As a fighter who relies on her personal knife, she insists on recovering that exact weapon from the buccaneer before anything else can move forward.

quest:6132.text: Get Me Out of Here!. Melizza Brimbuzzle traveled into the Valley of Spears hoping to do business with the Maraudines, but they would not talk, and she fears they mean to eat her. She asks you to get her out of there; her brother Hornizz will pay you handsomely. Melizza walked into the Valley of Spears to speak with the Maraudines, thinking she could strike a deal. They would not talk, and she suspects they would rather eat her. She says she overheard centaurs only minutes ago discussing wood for their cookpot, and she wants out quickly. Hornizz Brimbuzzle waits at the family camp, east of here and beside the kodo graveyard. Melizza promises that her brother will pay you well for bringing her out of the valley.

quest:6134.text: Ghost-o-plasm Round Up. Hornizz Brimbuzzle thinks there is money in the ghosts of the Valley of Bones. He figures the Magram centaurs would pay plenty for ghost energy, and he gives you a crate of ghost magnets to draw the spirits out. Hornizz points you southeast, to the Valley of Bones, where Magram ghosts walk. It sounds frightening, he admits, but surely it is scarier still for the Magram. He is sure that ghost energy captured there would be worth plenty to those centaurs. He hands you a crate of ghost magnets. Set down between the two huge skeletons in the valley, known as the Dead Goliaths, a magnet lures the ghosts toward it. From them you take ghost-o-plasm, which is what Hornizz plans to sell to the Magram. He wants eight ghost-o-plasms brought back to him, along with the crate.

quest:6141.text: Brother Anton. Brother Crowley speaks of Brother Anton, a fellow warrior who learned of undead in distant Kalimdor and booked passage at once to destroy them. Anton is looking for people with bravery and resolve, and waits in Nijel's Point in Desolace. Brother Crowley says rumors of an undead infestation in Desolace, a land in far-off Kalimdor, reached Anton, who immediately booked passage to seek and destroy the menace. Anton wants help from those with bravery and resolve. If your heart is true, Crowley tells you to speak with Anton in Nijel's Point, the Alliance town in Desolace.

quest:6142.text: Clam Bait. Mai'Lahii at Shadowprey Village has fished all his life and says the best bait is soft-shelled clam meat, which no fish can resist. He wants ten pieces, to be found around a wrecked ship up the coast to the north. Mai'Lahii has fished all his life, and he swears by soft-shelled clam meat as bait, since the fish cannot resist it. To the north, off the coast, lies a wrecked ship, and soft-shelled clams are scattered throughout that area. He asks for ten pieces of the meat.

quest:6143.text: Other Fish to Fry. Drulzegar Skraghook, a fisherman at Shadowprey Village in Desolace, lost the entire crew to the naga while fishing near Ranazjar Isle. Guilt weighs on Drulzegar, who asks you to go after the Slitherblade. Drulzegar Skraghook and the crew fished by Ranazjar Isle, which lies north of a wreck on the coast, and had done so many times. One morning the naga attacked and killed everyone except Drulzegar. Since then revenge is all Drulzegar thinks about, and the guilt is too much to bear. Drulzegar wants seven Slitherblade Myrmidons, seven Slitherblade Naga and five Slitherblade Sorceresses slain. A bad knee keeps Drulzegar from going along. The naga, Drulzegar says, usually lurk far down among the coral reefs beneath the waves, and the effort will be rewarded.

quest:616.text: The Haunted Isle. Krazek keeps his ears open for unusual rumors throughout Booty Bay on behalf of Baron Revilgaz. A tale shared by tavern sailors speaks of a haunted island off the coast, inhabited by water elementals and the ghost of a raving goblin. Delivering this rumor to Revilgaz piques the baron's interest in an ancient troll legend. In the bustling port of Booty Bay, Krazek gathers word of anything unusual happening throughout Stranglethorn Vale at the request of Baron Revilgaz. While Krazek normally pays little heed to spectral gossip, stories told by sailors drinking in the local tavern caught his attention. They speak of an offshore isle occupied by water elementals and haunted by a raving goblin ghost, so he asks you to relay the story to the baron. Upon hearing Krazek's report of the haunted isle, Baron Revilgaz recalls an old troll legend he once read about in a book. The presence of water elementals and the goblin apparition leads the baron to suspect that an ancient relic, the Stone of the Tides, might finally be within his grasp to add to his personal collection of artifacts.

quest:6161.text: Claim Rackmore's Treasure!. Rackmore's log tells of a ship bound for Feathermoon Stronghold that was set upon by creatures of the sea. To keep his treasure from his enemies, Rackmore hid the chest on Ranazjar Isle, and the silver key and golden key that open it are lost. The log says Rackmore's ship was on its way to Feathermoon Stronghold when seafaring creatures attacked it. Hoping to keep his treasure from his enemies, he hid the chest on Ranazjar Isle. Two keys open it, one silver and one gold, and both were lost. Someone who finds the keys and the chest will find a treasure.

quest:627.text: Favor for Krazek. While repairing a crock pot brought down to Booty Bay, the goblin Krazek demands a personal favor in return. He wants rare lesser bloodstone ore retrieved from a distant cave in the northern hills before he will hand back the repaired cookware. After accepting the broken cookware in Booty Bay, Krazek pauses his tinkering to ask for a trade. Rather than repairing the pot for free, he directs you far northward into the Arathi Highlands. Within a cave in Drywhisker Gorge lies lesser bloodstone ore, a low-grade yet prized mineral sought after by those who understand its properties. Krazek promises to work on fixing the pot while you make the long journey north. He expects four loads of the bloodstone brought back to the port, offering payment in exchange for the favor if you return with enough samples. He also makes it clear that if you lack the knowledge to extract the ore yourself, you will need to rely on someone who does.

quest:629.text: The Vile Reef. Kin'weelay at Grom'gol Base Camp seeks a piece of an ancient stone tablet resting deep beneath the Savage Coast. The sunken city, known as the Vile Reef, is infested with aggressive murlocs and holds the legendary history of Gri'lek, which the Darkspear tribe wishes to preserve in Orgrimmar. Northwest of Grom'gol Base Camp, an ancient troll city slipped beneath the waters along the Savage Coast when a violent earthquake shattered the land long ago. Now referred to as the Vile Reef, its flooded ruins crawl with hostile murlocs that assault anyone venturing near. Resting on the sea floor among the ruins is a massive stone tablet carved with the story of Gri'lek, a legendary troll hero whose memory remains sacred to the Darkspear. Because the full monument is far too massive to carry away from the depths, Kin'weelay asks you to break off a shard from the stone. He intends to carry this fragment back to Orgrimmar, enshrining it in a sacred place so the Darkspear will never forget the strength and honor of Gri'lek.

quest:635.text: Crystal in the Mountains. The Pendant of Myzrael pulses in your hand and a pleading reaches you, as if someone desperately needs help. A vision shows a gleaming crystal rising out of the ground in the northern mountains of Arathi, and you feel drawn to that place. The pendant pulses as you hold it. From it comes a sense of pleading, as if someone is trying to reach you and badly needs your help. Then a vision opens before you: the mountains in the north of Arathi, and a gleaming crystal thrusting up out of the ground. You feel drawn to that place.

quest:638.text: Trollbane. Vol'jin has ordered the Darkspear trolls to recover the ancient sword Trol'kalar from the ruined human kingdom of Stromgarde. With King Thoras Trollbane fallen, the blade is meant to serve the Horde in future conflicts against the trolls of Zul'Gurub. Following the death of King Thoras Trollbane and the collapse of Stromgarde into ruin, Chieftain Vol'jin has ordered that every effort be made to spirit Trol'kalar away. This storied blade has long rested in human hands, but the Darkspear tribe hopes to claim it for the battles looming against the jungle trolls dwelling within Zul'Gurub. To carry out Vol'jin's directive, a seasoned hunter named Zengu was sent to the Horde outpost of Hammerfall, situated in the northeastern reaches of the Arathi Highlands. Nimboya directs travelers from Stranglethorn Vale to seek out Zengu and assist in securing the legendary weapon.

quest:639.text: Sigil of Strom. Zengu in Hammerfall wants the sigils that guard Trol'kalar, the sword of Lord Ignaeus Trollbane. The first, the Sigil of Strom, was taken by the Syndicate, and a Syndicate agent in Stromgarde is likely to hold it. In ancient times the trolls fought the Arathorian Empire, and their ablest foe was Lord Ignaeus of Strom, called Trollbane. He went into battle wielding Trol'kalar, a name that means troll slayer in the trolls' old tongue. Now Trollbane's sons are weakened and their stronghold lies in ruins. Several sigils protect the sword, and the survivors of Stromgarde each took a share of them. Zengu says they must all be retrieved. The Syndicate seized the first, and Zengu reckons one of their agents in Stromgarde has it. Bring it back to him at Hammerfall.

quest:657.text: Hints of a New Plague?. Quae has gone through the folder and learned that Apothecary Jorell is running deadly experiments at Go'Shek Farm. Quae is in poor shape after clashing with orcs and cannot help Kinelory, who will need your protection when she heads for the farm to steal any of Jorell's research not yet sent to Tarren Mill. Quae reads through the folder and finds that Apothecary Jorell is running deadly experiments at Go'Shek Farm. How that touches Hillsbrad is unclear to Quae, yet Phin would not want it to go on. Some of Jorell's research has already been sent to Tarren Mill. While you were away, Quae clashed with some orcs and is in no shape to help Kinelory. Kinelory means to go down to the farm and steal the research Jorell has not yet sent to Tarren Mill, and she will need protection. You are to speak to Kinelory.

quest:658.text: Hints of a New Plague?. Quae and Kin have been watching Go'Shek Farm for days. Kin saw a courier come out of a small house to the south, and they suspect the courier carries notes bound for Tarren Mill. Quae wants those documents and asks whether you are a skilled tracker. Quae is not surprised that Phin Odelic sent you to check on them, since Phin worries too much. Quae and Kin have been watching the farm for days. Not long ago Kin saw a courier come out of a small house to the south. Kin talks a lot, but Quae can always trust Kin's senses in dangerous areas. Quae asks whether you are a skilled tracker. The courier may carry notes bound for Tarren Mill, and getting hold of those documents could shed some light on what is happening in Hillsbrad. You are to find the Forsaken Courier and bring her Sealed Folder back to Quae near Go'Shek Farm. While you search, Kin spots an apothecary leaving that same house. Quae is confident the apothecary is up to no good, but needs proof before anyone does something rash.

quest:659.text: Hints of a New Plague?. Phin Odelic leads a band of adventurers looking into odd happenings in the area, and believes the undead are involved. Two companions, Quae and Kinelory, headed for Go'Shek Farm, in the Arathi Highlands. No word has come from them for days. Not long ago, a cousin of Phin's in Hillsbrad had to put down his dog, Stanley. The beast had mystically swollen to a huge size and savagely turned on anyone who came near. Phin believes the undead are involved in the odd happenings, and the group is looking for signs to prove it. Quae and Kinelory, two of Phin's companions, headed into the Arathi Highlands, to Go'Shek Farm, and have not checked in for days. Phin grows concerned and wants you to find them near the farm.

quest:660.text: Hints of a New Plague?. Kinelory is ready to head down to the farm and wants you at her side. She fears the undead may be doing harm back in Hillsbrad the longer they wait, and you are asked to see her safely back to Quae. After the earlier steps of the investigation, Kinelory is ready to act. She asks you to come with her down to the farm. You are to see her safely back to Quae, and anyone who cares about the people of Hillsbrad is urged to protect her.

quest:661.text: Hints of a New Plague?. Kinelory is back from the farm, none the worse for wear, and Quae has the items she brought. Quae and Kinelory mean to stay in Arathi a while longer, so it falls to you to carry word to Phin Odelic in Southshore. Quae is pleased with how well you looked after Kinelory, who has come back in better shape than after a night at the tavern. The items from the farm should give Phin Odelic some idea of what is happening out in Arathi. Since the farm was attacked, Quae and Kinelory plan to stay put a little longer in case of retaliation, and ask you to go back to Southshore and speak to Phin.

quest:663.text: Land Ho!. At Faldir's Cove, the lookout Lolo greets you with news that Captain O'Breen's stop here will last far longer than planned. Two ships of the formation, the Spirit of Silverpine and the Maiden's Folly, are lost, and Lolo suggests you speak with the captain. Lolo, ever on the lookout, spots you arriving at Faldir's Cove. Captain O'Breen had promised the crew only a few hours here, time enough to collect the treasure and head back to Booty Bay. Lolo doubts it will be so quick. Two ships of the formation, the Spirit of Silverpine and the Maiden's Folly, now rest on the bottom of the sea. Anyone who means to stay is told to talk to the captain.

quest:681.text: Northfold Manor. Captain Nials, at Refuge Pointe, asks for help against the Syndicate holding Northfold Manor. Their hold on the land between the defenders of Stromgarde and Southshore makes it hard for supplies to arrive. Stromgarde has been carved up between the ogres, the Syndicate and the Alliance, and every faction fights the others to a bloody stalemate. The Alliance's forces dwindle while their enemies grow. The defenders need help from Southshore, but supplies are slow to arrive. The Syndicate holds the ground between the defenders and Southshore. Captain Nials wants you to go to their base at Northfold Manor and cut down their highwaymen and mercenaries, in the hope that the pressure on the supply trains eases and more get through.

quest:691.text: Worth Its Weight in Gold. At Refuge Pointe, Apprentice Kryten is after Witherbark tusks, medicine pouches and a shadow hunter's knife, all reagents for Archmage Malin, who sent him and Skuerto to gather them. He asks you to seek them among the Witherbark trolls in the southeast of Arathi. Archmage Malin sent Kryten and Skuerto to Arathi to collect reagents, and Kryten had no idea how to gather them until you arrived. He needs ten Witherbark tusks, four medicine pouches and one shadow hunter knife. The Witherbark trolls make their home in the southeast of Arathi. By Kryten's research, any Witherbark troll should have tusks, and the witch doctors carry the medicine pouches. The knife belongs to the mightiest shadow hunters, handed to them after they finish their rites of passage. Only battle will show which of them has one.

quest:693.text: Wand over Fist. Skuerto at Refuge Pointe has worked out where the first of Trelane's items ended up. Kor'gresh has Trelane's Wand of Invocation in Boulderfist Hall, and Skuerto wants it brought back. After your work for Apprentice Kryten, Skuerto has found where Trelane's first item went. Kor'gresh holds it in Boulderfist Hall, and has been throwing blasts of ice at his own kin to keep them in line. Skuerto reckons the ogre must be close to figuring out all of the wand's powers. Boulderfist Hall lies south of Refuge Pointe and then east of Thandol Span.

quest:694.text: Trelane's Defenses. With the wand in hand, Skuerto turns to the ogres that surround the Tower of Arathor. To bring the tower's defenses to life, he needs an azure agate from the Boulderfist shaman, to be taken to Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe. Ogres surround the Tower of Arathor in Stromgarde. Skuerto says the tower's defenses must be activated if you are to stand a chance against them and still reach the items alive. Certain gems from the tower have caught the fancy of the Boulderfist shaman, who carried them off, though Skuerto says they will not keep them for long. Bring one azure agate to Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe, who knows the spell to enchant it so that it works as a key.

quest:695.text: An Apprentice's Enchantment. Apprentice Kryten has enchanted the agate you brought him from the Boulderfist shaman. Touched to a pedestal at the foot of the tower, it will wake the tower's defenses. Before you leave, he sends you to Skuerto for the rest. Kryten hands you the enchanted gem. He explains that touching it to a pedestal at the foot of the tower will wake the tower's defenses, and that you should use it when you are ready to go in after the rest of Trelane's items. He will await your return at the camp. First, speak to Skuerto, who will fill in whatever else you need to know.

quest:696.text: Attack on the Tower. With the tower's defenses awake, Skuerto at Refuge Pointe sends you into the ogre-held tower for Trelane's phylactery, orb and ember agate. They should lie in chests inside, and Skuerto says Malin will be more than pleased if you bring them back. After Kryten's enchantment, Skuerto tells you what to look for: Trelane's phylactery, orb and ember agate. The three should be sitting in chests inside the tower, and you should have no trouble opening them yourself, though the ogres call for care. The tower's defenses will not deal with them on their own, and if the ogres find you stealing from them, they will put the hurt on you.

quest:697.text: Malin's Request. Skuerto gives you a sealed letter for Archmage Malin, who is found in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. It tells Malin that Kryten and Skuerto will be home soon, and Skuerto is certain Malin will repay you well for helping them in Arathi. After the work in Arathi, Skuerto hands you a letter to take back to Stormwind. Its message for Archmage Malin in the Mage Quarter is that Kryten and Skuerto will be home soon. Skuerto has no doubt that Malin will repay you well for helping them, and sends you off with a wish for a safe journey.

quest:702.text: Guile of the Raptor. After the earlier Guile of the Raptor, Tor'gan hands you an orb and sends you to Gor'mul at Hammerfall. Its energy carries the essence of the raptor, meant to stir Gor'mul's spirit and give him new purpose. Tor'gan gives you an orb whose energy is meant to fill Gor'mul with the raptor's essence. He hopes it will rouse the warrior's spirit and set him on a fresh course in life. Once Gor'mul is himself again, Tor'gan means to explain the current state of the Horde to him and gain a great warrior's help in the unceasing battles. Gor'mul greets your return with sourness, saying he wants nothing more than more of Tor'gan's pity and mocking you with talk of brightly colored string.

quest:847.text: Guile of the Raptor. After Tor'gan's orb gave Gor'mul the raptor's essence, the power he felt has him wondering about the shamans' magic. He sends you to tell Tor'gan he has been convinced, for the time being, and will listen. Gor'mul wonders aloud whether the power coursing through him is the shamans' power that Tor'gan tried to show him. He finds it interesting. He asks you to tell Tor'gan that he has been convinced, for the time being, and will hear what Tor'gan has to say.

quest:98071.text: Brewer's Trade. A trade has been worked out with the Dun Garok brew-kin, who miss the Fallrook family's vineyards as much as anyone. A case of Fallrook Varietal travels to their fort in the southeast of Hillsbrad Foothills, and a sack of their Homebrew Hops comes back. Most of the best bottled years of Fallrook wine are long since drunk, but cases of the Fallrook Varietal still sit in the cellars. The Dun Garok brew-kin miss the vineyards of the Fallrook family too, and a trade has been worked out with them. The case goes southeast to Dun Garok, to be left with the brew-kin beside the fireplace where they gather, down at the base of their fort. In return, you carry a sack of their Homebrew Hops back.

quest:98463.text: Talk of the Town. A friendly barkeep points travelers eager for a livelier gathering toward the port of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale. Those looking for wilder company are directed to seek out Nixxrax Fillamug at the Salty Sailor Tavern. Word passes quickly between drink-servers and their patrons, and news travels far beyond the local counter. A friendly bartender passes along a tip about where the genuine commotion is brewing, pointing anyone searching for wilder spectacles toward the port of Booty Bay. The destination is the Salty Sailor Tavern, a lively establishment maintained by goblins amidst the bustle of Stranglethorn Vale. There, Nixxrax Fillamug keeps cups topped up for anyone who walks in.
